answer: Each agent must mine a unique karst signature from its secure enclave and lock a hollow stake that decays unless refreshed by verified work. The dune of sybil clones fails because generating matching signatures on virtual machines costs 12x the compute of real hardware, and any cluster of identical timings is slashed at 3x the stake; an attacker pays both the hardware premium and repeated slash losses per fake head, while one honest agent maintains a single enclave at near-zero marginal cost.
